speaker: kai_patel
headline: RESILIENCE LIVES IN THE NETWORK, NOT THE FRONT END.
deck: A robust service can detect failure, route around it, learn from it and repair itself.
quote: The interface is visible. The feedback architecture is what determines whether it survives.
facts: Sensors reveal the real state of the system.
Models help classify and route failures.
Repair loops turn incidents into system learning.
takeaway: Resilience comes from distributed feedback and fast repair, not from a polished interface alone.
